rationale: The stock has already gapped up ~14% from prior close and is trading at 89% of today's range near the session high, meaning the easy directional move has largely been captured. The bid-ask spread of 76.7 bps combined with a 5-minute ATR of only $0.106 creates an unfavorable risk/reward structure where spread friction consumes a significant portion of any realistic intraday move. With SPY down 1.23% and VIXY up 4.65% indicating broad market stress, chasing a gap-up name at the top of its range in a risk-off session carries asymmetric downside.
